chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Ahmad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Uthman (and Abi Uthman's name is Abd al-Wahhab ibn Habib), who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah al-Thumali reported to us from Muawiya ibn Ammar al-Duhni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The night prayer beautifies the face, removes anxiety, and clears the vision.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of night prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the holistic benefits of Salat al-Layl, linking spiritual devotion to tangible physical and psychological well-being. The triad of beautifying the face, removing anxiety (hamm), and clarifying vision reflects the Shia understanding of the body as a trust that is purified through consistent night worship, a practice deeply rooted in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt.
